You will transform complex datasets into meaningful insights through interactive dashboards, automated reports, and sophisticated data models. Working with Power BI and the Microsoft Power Platform, you will contribute to the integration and optimization of enterprise data solutions. You will collaborate with different stakeholders to understand business needs and deliver effective, data-driven solutions.   • Conduct exploratory data analysis and transform raw data into actionable insights that support evidence-based decision-making.
  • Integrate Business Intelligence solutions with corporate tools and platforms to automate processes and improve data management.
  • Design and develop management applications and automated workflows using Power Apps and Power Automate.
  • Create automated reports and interactive visualizations tailored to the needs of different stakeholders.

As a PPC Specialist, you will manage and optimise paid advertising campaigns for a digital marketing agency working with multiple clients across different industries. You will play a key role in driving measurable results, improving campaign performance and maximising return on advertising investment. Working primarily with Google Ads, you will oversee multiple accounts, manage budgets and develop data-driven strategies to achieve client objectives. You will combine analytical thinking with hands-on campaign management, from keyword research and ad copy testing to conversion tracking and performance reporting. Collaborating with internal marketing, creative and web teams, you will identify opportunities for continuous improvement. This fully remote opportunity is ideal for an organised and proactive professional who enjoys working in a dynamic, results-oriented environment.

lists.content:
• Build, launch, manage and continuously optimise paid search campaigns, primarily through Google Ads.
  • Oversee multiple client advertising accounts, managing budgets, bidding strategies, audience targeting and conversion objectives.
  • Conduct keyword research, develop compelling advertising copy and perform ongoing testing to improve campaign effectiveness.
  • Monitor and analyse campaign performance using key metrics, including CPA, ROAS, CTR and conversion rates.
  • Identify performance trends, inefficiencies and growth opportunities, implementing actionable optimisation strategies.
  • Set up, validate and troubleshoot conversion tracking to ensure accurate measurement and reliable reporting.
  • Analyse landing-page performance and recommend improvements to increase engagement and conversion rates.
  • Coordinate with creative, web development and internal marketing teams to implement campaign improvements.
  • Prepare clear, structured and insightful performance reports for clients, highlighting results, recommendations and next steps.
  • Maintain proactive communication with colleagues and clients regarding campaign priorities, progress, results and potential challenges.
  • Manage competing deadlines while ensuring accuracy, consistency and high-quality delivery across all assigned accounts.

    • Requirements:

  • Demonstrated professional experience managing PPC and paid search campaigns, preferably within a digital marketing agency or multi-client environment.
  • Strong practical knowledge of Google Ads, including campaign creation, budget management, bidding strategies, audience targeting and optimisation.
  • Good working knowledge of Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and digital advertising performance measurement.
  • Hands-on experience with conversion tracking implementation, validation and troubleshooting.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret campaign data and translate insights into practical optimisation decisions.
  • Understanding of key digital advertising metrics, including CPA, ROAS, CTR and conversion rates.
  • Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple accounts and competing priorities.
  • Strong written and spoken English skills for effective communication with international clients and internal teams.
  • Proactive communication style and the ability to identify issues, share updates and collaborate effectively.
  • Practical, hands-on mindset with a strong focus on continuous improvement and measurable business results.
  • Ability to work independently, demonstrate initiative and maintain consistent performance in a fully remote environment.
  • Based in Latin America, with reliable internet access and the ability to work remotely.

    • Benefits:

  • 100% remote: Work from anywhere in Latin America.
  • Full-time employment: Stable, full-time professional opportunity.
  • Flexible remote environment: No daily office commute required.
  • Professional development: Opportunity to gain experience managing multiple advertising accounts and working across different client campaigns.
  • Performance-driven environment: Develop your PPC expertise through hands-on campaign management and continuous optimisation.
  • Additional benefits: Further details regarding compensation, perks and other benefits will be discussed during the hiring process.

  • Manage architectural and transformation risks, acting as an escalation point for complex technical issues and key stakeholders.

  • Facilitate communication and alignment between C-level executives, business teams, engineering groups, and other technical stakeholders.

  • Define project performance metrics, identify improvement opportunities, and promote continuous optimization.

  • Mentor and develop other architects, identify technical talent, and support succession planning.

  • Act as a trusted technology advisor, translating architectural recommendations into measurable business value.

  • Ensure consistency in architecture and engineering standards across all project squads.

  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS, cloud architecture, and application deployment.

  • Solid software development experience with React, Java, and/or Node.js.

  • Proven experience in legacy Mainframe modernization projects, particularly migrating COBOL, JCL, CICS, and DB2 environments to the cloud.

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, and container-based architectures.

  • Strong knowledge of APIs, API Gateways, IAM, authentication, authorization, secrets management, and networking.

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, and Infrastructure as Code.

  • Knowledge of applying AI technologies to software development.

  • Demonstrated ability to configure, integrate, and optimize AI agent ecosystems.

  • Understanding of modern architectures, distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architectures, and messaging queues.

  • Experience with observability practices, including logging, metrics, and tracing.

  • Ability to work across the full technology lifecycle, from architecture and implementation to production operations.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to resolve complex technical challenges.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal Database Engineer based in Brazil.

As a Principal Database Engineer, you will shape the architecture, reliability, and long-term evolution of critical database infrastructure supporting high-demand financial services. You will assess complex production environments, define technical direction, and lead the delivery of improvements that strengthen performance, scalability, and operational resilience. Working hands-on with MariaDB and complementary data technologies, you will guide challenging migrations, resolve complex incidents, and develop automation for safer database operations. You will collaborate with engineering, security, and compliance teams, influencing decisions across the organization without relying on formal management authority. This is a senior individual contributor opportunity for someone who combines deep technical expertise with strategic judgment, practical execution, and a strong commitment to dependable infrastructure.

lists.content:
• Assess existing database infrastructure against business needs and production performance, identifying opportunities to improve reliability, scalability, cost efficiency, and operational simplicity.

  • Define target database architecture, establish measurable technical objectives, and develop a prioritized roadmap in collaboration with engineering leaders and dependent teams.

  • Lead the implementation and adoption of architectural improvements, remaining hands-on with complex migrations, scaling decisions, benchmarking, data-integrity validation, and cutover and rollback planning.

  • Diagnose complex MariaDB performance issues and failures across database engines, storage systems, and application layers.

  • Improve production reliability through observability, safer change management, and tested backup, restoration, and disaster recovery procedures.

  • Establish recovery objectives with service owners and validate them through practical recovery exercises.

  • Build and maintain production software and automation for database provisioning, upgrades, failover, online schema changes, and routine maintenance.

  • Develop secure, auditable self-service database workflows in partnership with Security and Compliance teams.

  • Advise application teams on schema design, transaction boundaries, query optimization, and appropriate data-store choices.

  • Mentor engineers through design reviews, technical collaboration, pairing, and incident analysis, encouraging ownership and stronger database expertise.

  • Participate in on-call rotations and incident response, ensuring clear operational ownership and continuous improvement based on production lessons.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 8 years of experience operating and evolving large-scale production database environments, including assessing existing systems, defining technical direction, and delivering measurable improvements.

  • Deep, recent, hands-on expertise with MariaDB, particularly InnoDB, MVCC, transaction isolation, locking, query optimization, binary logs, and MariaDB GTID replication.

  • Strong understanding of high availability, replication, distributed database failure modes, consistency and availability trade-offs, transaction boundaries, and reliable event delivery patterns such as transactional outbox.

  • Proven experience independently diagnosing MariaDB incidents, tuning performance, and executing tested restore or point-in-time recovery procedures while validating data integrity.

  • Strong software engineering skills in Python, Go, Rust, or a comparable programming language.

  • Experience personally developing and maintaining production software or automation for database provisioning, failover, online schema changes, and self-service operations.

  • Familiarity with version control, code reviews, delivery pipelines, and robust failure-handling practices.

  • Strong knowledge of Linux internals, operating system kernels, storage, and networking, with the ability to investigate issues beyond the database layer.

  • Excellent written communication and technical judgment, with a demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and deliver cross-team initiatives without direct reporting authority.

  • Proven ability to mentor experienced engineers and support sound technical and lifecycle decisions.

  • Nice to have: Experience with containerized, hybrid on-premises and cloud, or multi-region database environments, including Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, and GitOps.

  • Nice to have: Familiarity with database proxies and load-balancing technologies such as MaxScale, HAProxy, or ProxySQL.

  • Nice to have: Experience with PostgreSQL, Vitess, TiDB, ScyllaDB, ClickHouse, or internal database platforms, as well as Kafka, Redis/Valkey, or Elasticsearch/OpenSearch.

  • Nice to have: Experience working in regulated environments or contributing to database engines, operators, and infrastructure software.

    • Benefits:

  • Competitive annual salary range of USD 161,000–358,900, with the final offer determined by experience, skills, and role scope.

  • Equity opportunities.

  • Performance-based bonus program.

  • Wellness allowance.

  • For eligible US employees, additional medical, dental, and vision coverage, as well as a 401(k) plan.

  • Fully remote, full-time employment arrangement.

  • Opportunity to influence critical infrastructure and contribute to complex, high-impact engineering initiatives.

As Procurement Lead, you will take ownership of the commercial and vendor-management function, with a strong focus on financial operations (FinOps) and cost optimization. You will oversee strategic cloud and SaaS vendor relationships, lead contract negotiations, and establish effective procurement governance. This is an opportunity to build and shape a procurement function from the ground up, defining its operating model, processes, and reporting standards. Working closely with Finance, Engineering, Legal, and external partners, you will turn complex spending data into actionable insights and measurable savings. In a fully remote, globally distributed environment, you will have the autonomy to make strategic decisions and deliver meaningful business impact.

lists.content:

  • Lead the Procurement and FinOps function, defining its operating model, roadmap, processes, and standards while ensuring alignment with wider business objectives.

  • Manage and develop direct reports by overseeing onboarding, performance management, career development, regular one-to-ones, and day-to-day team administration.

  • Drive the team's delivery and accountability through roadmap management, project tracking, workflow prioritization, and stakeholder communication.

  • Improve commercial visibility and unit economics by monitoring vendor expenditure, identifying licensing inefficiencies, analyzing usage patterns, and driving renewals, right-sizing, and tooling consolidation to achieve measurable savings.

  • Build and maintain vendor and SaaS cost dashboards and reporting systems, working hands-on with data and partnering with internal teams to scale reporting capabilities.

  • Define and maintain spending policies, governance frameworks, accountability standards, and cost-control thresholds.

  • Coordinate cloud cost-efficiency initiatives, tracking optimization opportunities from initial commitment through to realized savings in partnership with Engineering teams.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 8 years of experience in procurement, vendor or commercial management, FinOps, or technical and financial analysis, including senior-level ownership of a function or strategic area.

  • Proven experience managing strategic vendor relationships, negotiating commercial agreements, and overseeing contract renewals.

  • Strong understanding of procurement governance, including competitive bidding, contract benchmarking, approval processes, and managed-procurement partnerships.

  • Hands-on experience building cost dashboards and reporting solutions using SQL, business intelligence tools, or similar analytical technologies.

  • Comfortable analyzing cloud infrastructure expenditure, particularly AWS and GCP costs, SaaS billing, licensing structures, and usage data.

  • Strong financial and analytical capabilities, with the ability to translate complex spending information into actionable insights and measurable business outcomes.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical teams.

  • Strong judgment, strategic thinking, and the ability to influence decisions, build consensus, and drive alignment without relying on formal authority.

  • Experience working in asynchronous, remote-first, or globally distributed organizations.

  • Proven ability to build processes and functions from the ground up, take ownership, and navigate ambiguity in fast-moving environments.

  • Demonstrated people-management skills, including team development, performance management, and fostering a high-trust working culture.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the world, with a WeWork membership or co-working allowance to support your preferred working environment.

  • Flexible Working Arrangements: Enjoy an asynchronous working culture with the autonomy to organize your schedule and manage your priorities.

  • Exposure to cutting-edge open-source technologies, developer tools, and innovative AI-driven solutions.

  • Own, refine, and manage delivery backlogs for two AI Pod teams.

  • Translate established product priorities into detailed user stories, functional requirements, and measurable acceptance criteria.

  • Break initiatives into clearly scoped epics, stories, and tasks, with well-defined criteria for readiness and completion.

  • Maintain prioritized, development-ready backlog items ahead of each sprint.

  • Coordinate with Product Managers and other Product Owners to validate requirements and obtain sign-off for dependent features.

  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, and retrospectives.

  • Collaborate with Engineering to clarify scope, resolve blockers, and escalate dependencies and delivery risks.

  • User Acceptance Testing & Quality Validation

  • Plan and execute UAT for AI Pod deliverables and provide release sign-off.

  • Record, document, and prioritize defects, then verify fixes before closing them.

  • Document UAT results, defects, and AI output evaluation findings in clear, structured, and repeatable formats.

  • Prepare release-level test summaries covering test scope, results, known issues, and recommended follow-up actions.

  • Keep user stories, acceptance criteria, test cases, and supporting documentation accurate and up to date.

  • Provide Product Marketing with feature details and release information needed for go-to-market materials.

  • Own product analytics for Ask Numa and Homeowner Assist, monitoring adoption, usage, and engagement.

  • Analyze customer behavior, questions, and feedback to identify friction points, gaps in AI responses, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Build and maintain recurring usage and performance reports for product leadership.

  • Translate analytical findings into actionable backlog items and use data to support prioritization decisions.

  • AI & Automation Workflow Enablement

  • Analyze and document end-to-end workflows that could benefit from AI-driven automation.

  • Opportunity to strengthen and develop product management skills through hands-on experience in AI product delivery.

We are looking for an experienced Programs Manager to drive revenue growth initiatives across an international client portfolio, with a primary focus on SMB customers and expansion into larger accounts. In this senior individual contributor role, you will own the end-to-end development and execution of scalable commercial growth programs. You will leverage advanced data analytics, pricing strategies, and A/B experimentation to identify opportunities, improve retention, and generate incremental revenue. Working closely with Commercial, Finance, Product, Marketing, and Operations teams, you will turn business insights into measurable growth strategies. You will also build and scale AI-powered and automated workflows to streamline execution and reduce manual processes. This is an opportunity to shape a high-impact global growth function while contributing to innovative, data-driven commercial initiatives.

lists.content:

You will collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to identify opportunities, optimize pricing and renewal strategies, and introduce automation that supports sustainable business growth.

  • Own and scale the global Revenue Growth strategy in partnership with Commercial Leadership, Value Management, and Sales Operations.

  • Manage end-to-end monthly program execution, including SQL-based cohort identification, price-increase initiatives, waiver and discount strategies, and performance tracking against budgets and targets.

  • Define opportunities to expand programmatic growth initiatives into larger client segments, determining appropriate customer cohorts, commercial levers, and pricing guidelines.

  • Design, implement, and evaluate A/B experiments with clear hypotheses and success metrics to improve revenue generation and operational efficiency.

  • Lead monthly and quarterly Revenue Growth business reviews with Commercial, Operations, and Finance leadership.

  • Prepare executive summaries and communicate program performance, financial results, and operational health to senior leadership.

  • Partner with Commercial Finance and Sales Operations to assess financial impact, compare expected and actual results, and forecast revenue growth across the existing customer base.

  • Influence the development and prioritization of new revenue initiatives with Product, Product Marketing, Client Marketing, Customer Experience, and Commercial teams.

  • Identify opportunities to increase incremental client revenue, improve net revenue margins, and enhance customer communication and operational efficiency.

  • Develop AI-powered and automated workflows, determining which processes should be automated and where human judgment remains essential.

  • Take automation initiatives from initial prototypes through production, ensuring continuity and successful implementation.

  • Analyze net margins across the SMB customer portfolio to identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Maintain performance dashboards and retention-guideline discount calculators, ensuring alignment with current Value Management recommendations.

  • Scale successful go-to-market strategies globally by sharing insights and providing operational guidance to commercial and channel partner teams.

  • Define future development priorities for the Client Console in collaboration with Product Development and Analytics teams.

  • Analyze large datasets using SQL to monitor key performance indicators, including Net Revenue Retention (NRR), renewal rates, and Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) churn at renewal.

  • Translate complex analytical findings into actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Promote a supportive and collaborative work environment that encourages wellbeing, balance, and continuous improvement.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate is a strategic, analytical, and commercially minded professional with a strong background in pricing, revenue operations, growth strategy, or program management.   • Proven experience in pricing, revenue operations, growth strategy, or analytical program management.

  • Demonstrated success developing and scaling commercial initiatives that generate measurable revenue growth.

  • Advanced SQL skills and experience analyzing large datasets, identifying customer cohorts, and tracking business performance.

  • Strong practical knowledge of Salesforce and business intelligence tools, such as Looker Studio.

  • Experience building dashboards and monitoring key metrics, including NRR, renewal rates, MRR churn, and net revenue margins.

  • In-depth understanding of pricing strategies, customer renewals, discount structures, and commercial performance.

  • Experience designing and managing A/B experiments, defining success metrics, and translating results into actionable recommendations.

  • Ability to partner with Finance teams to forecast revenue impact, analyze financial performance, and evaluate actual results against expectations.

  • Hands-on interest and experience in AI, workflow automation, and agentic solutions, including taking automated workflows from prototype to production.

  • Strong judgment in identifying processes suitable for automation while recognizing situations that require human intervention.

  • Excellent project and program management skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives independently.

  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, particularly across Commercial, Product, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Experience teams.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience leading business reviews and presenting executive-level performance summaries.

  • Ability to communicate technical insights clearly to audiences with different levels of technical expertise.

  • Fluency in both English and Portuguese is mandatory to support global collaboration and local operations.

  • Free Gold+ wellness membership, providing access to gyms, fitness studios, digital fitness programs, meditation, nutrition, and other wellbeing resources.

  • Access to a comprehensive emotional wellbeing program, including up to 52 individual therapy sessions per year and on-demand resources.

  • Health, dental, and life insurance.

  • Flexible-first working model with remote and hybrid options, with the specific arrangement discussed during the recruitment process.

  • Home office reimbursement to help create a comfortable and productive workspace.

  • Flexible working hours, with schedules coordinated around time zones, team requirements, and individual routines.

  • Paid vacation eligibility after six months of employment.

  • Three additional days off per year, plus one extra day for every year of tenure, up to five additional days.

  • An additional day off to celebrate your birthday.

  • 100% paid parental leave for all new parents, with extended leave and a gradual part-time return option for birth parents.

  • Professional development opportunities through learning platforms, interactive sessions, personalized development plans, and internal career opportunities.

  • A collaborative and inclusive work environment that values transparency, diverse perspectives, teamwork, and employee wellbeing.

We are looking for an experienced Quality Engineer to play a key role in strengthening quality engineering practices and driving continuous improvement across the organization. In this position, you will help shape testing strategies, advance automation capabilities, and embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle. You will collaborate closely with product and engineering teams, anticipating risks and influencing technical decisions to deliver reliable, scalable, and sustainable solutions. As a technical reference, you will mentor other quality engineers and contribute to the evolution of testing standards, frameworks, and best practices. lists.content:
• Technical Leadership and Mentoring: Act as a technical reference in Quality Engineering, mentoring and supporting the professional development of other Quality Engineers. Influence quality-related technical decisions and contribute to the evolution of standards, frameworks, playbooks, and initiatives across the engineering chapter.
  • Quality from the Start: Participate in product discovery, pre-refinement, refinement, and solution design discussions to ensure quality is considered from the earliest stages of development. Identify potential risks, dependencies, and technical or business impacts proactively.
  • Testing Strategy and Risk Management: Define quality strategies for new initiatives, conduct risk assessments, and establish appropriate functional, technical, and operational test coverage. Recommend approaches to testing, observability, rollout strategies, and risk mitigation.
  • Test Automation: Develop, maintain, and continuously improve automated testing solutions, ensuring quality practices are integrated into continuous delivery pipelines and the overall test architecture.
  • Technical and Operational Quality: Perform and support testing across frontend, backend, APIs, and system integrations. Contribute to technical investigations, troubleshooting, and incident analysis to identify root causes and prevent recurring issues.
  • Monitoring and Observability: Use metrics, monitoring tools, logs, and observability practices to support technical decisions, identify quality gaps, and drive continuous improvement.
  • AI-Driven Engineering: Leverage AI-powered tools to accelerate analysis, improve automation, and increase engineering productivity. Explore and implement new opportunities to apply artificial intelligence within Quality Engineering workflows.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to promote shared ownership of quality and ensure technical solutions meet functional and operational expectations.

  • Ability to integrate quality activities into development workflows and collaborate effectively with software engineering teams.
  • Experience with observability practices, including logs, metrics, monitoring, incident analysis, and technical troubleshooting.

  • Results-driven approach, adaptability, and willingness to challenge existing practices to promote continuous improvement.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Quality Manager, Vendor Compliance based in Brazil.

We are looking for a Quality Manager, Vendor Compliance to oversee supplier quality, food safety, and regulatory compliance across a network of ingredient suppliers, manufacturing partners, and fulfillment facilities. You will own the quality systems and processes that ensure materials and finished products consistently meet established standards. Working closely with Procurement, Regulatory, R&D, and Supply Chain, you will lead supplier qualification, audits, risk assessments, and corrective action programs. You will also manage ingredient verification, quality documentation, and supplier performance monitoring to identify and address potential issues proactively. This role combines hands-on quality oversight with strategic supplier partnerships and continuous improvement initiatives. You will contribute to a collaborative, fast-moving environment where product integrity, accountability, and consumer trust are essential.

lists.content:
As Quality Manager, Vendor Compliance, you will take ownership of supplier quality programs and the systems used to maintain food safety, regulatory compliance, and reliable manufacturing standards. You will work across internal teams and external partners to identify risks, resolve quality issues, strengthen supplier performance, and ensure documentation remains accurate and audit-ready.

  • Supplier Quality & Compliance

  • Own supplier qualification, approval, and compliance programs, ensuring suppliers and materials meet quality, food safety, regulatory, and business requirements.

  • Lead supplier and material onboarding in partnership with Procurement, Regulatory, R&D, and Supply Chain.

  • Establish and maintain risk-based supplier and ingredient assessments based on material risk, manufacturing processes, supplier performance, and historical quality data.

  • Lead supplier quality investigations, corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), and escalations, ensuring root causes are identified and corrective actions are sustainable.

  • Ensure suppliers comply with established requirements, including supplier expectation guidelines, specifications, quality standards, and applicable regulations.

  • Lead supplier audits and facility assessments while driving continuous improvement through effective supplier partnerships.

  • Ingredient Quality Management

  • Manage the ingredient positive release program, including certificate of analysis (COA) reviews, material disposition, and communication with warehouses and internal stakeholders.

  • Establish risk-based ingredient testing and verification programs to confirm materials meet quality and food safety specifications.

  • Oversee ingredient retention sample and traceability programs to support investigations and supplier performance evaluations.

  • Lead ingredient nonconformance investigations and coordinate appropriate supplier corrective actions and material disposition.

  • Monitor ingredient quality trends and variability to identify and mitigate emerging risks.

  • Quality Systems & Document Control

  • Own document control processes for Quality and Supply Chain documentation, including SOPs, forms, specifications, and work instructions.

  • Establish standards for document creation, review, approval, version control, archiving, and retention.

  • Ensure supplier compliance records remain complete, current, and audit-ready.

  • Coordinate periodic document reviews with cross-functional process owners to ensure procedures reflect current practices and requirements.

  • Continuously improve quality systems and documentation processes to strengthen compliance, traceability, and operational efficiency.

  • Supplier Performance & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop and manage supplier performance metrics and scorecards to track quality, compliance, recurring issues, and emerging risks.

  • Establish supplier performance review and escalation processes, including improvement plans for high-risk or underperforming suppliers.

  • Analyze supplier and ingredient quality trends to identify systemic risks and improvement opportunities.

  • Partner with Procurement and Supply Chain leadership on supplier approval, performance management, escalation, and disqualification decisions.

  • Provide leadership with visibility into supplier quality risks, significant nonconformances, and outstanding corrective actions.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate has 6–8+ years of Quality Assurance or Supplier Quality experience in the food and beverage industry, preferably within beverage manufacturing. You bring strong technical knowledge of food safety systems and supplier compliance, combined with the ability to manage investigations, audits, and corrective action programs. You are analytical, organized, and comfortable influencing external suppliers and internal stakeholders while managing competing priorities.

  • 6–8+ years of experience in Quality Assurance or Supplier Quality within the food and beverage industry; beverage experience is preferred.

  • 0–2 years of experience managing and developing technical team members.

  • Demonstrated experience managing supplier qualification, approval, compliance, and risk assessment programs.

  • Strong experience conducting supplier audits, managing quality investigations, and implementing CAPAs.

  • Thorough knowledge of food safety and quality systems, including:

  • Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs).

  • HACCP and Preventive Controls.

  • Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI) standards.

  • FDA and Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) requirements.

  • Experience managing supplier onboarding, approval, and compliance documentation through platforms such as TraceGains, FoodLogiQ, or FoodChain ID, keeping certificates, audits, and specifications current and audit-ready.

  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills and experience analyzing quality data and supplier performance metrics.

  • Excellent organizational and analytical abilities, with strong attention to detail.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence cross-functional partners and drive supplier accountability.

  • Ability to manage competing priorities, adapt to changing business needs, and promote continuous improvement.

  • A collaborative mindset and commitment to professional values such as humility, aspiration, integrity, accountability, and empathy.

    • Benefits:

  • Annual compensation of $120,000–$135,000, plus bonus.

  • Remote working arrangement.

  • Opportunity to take ownership of supplier quality and compliance programs across manufacturing and supply chain partners.

  • Cross-functional collaboration with Procurement, Regulatory, R&D, Supply Chain, and Quality teams.

  • Opportunity to drive continuous improvement and strengthen quality systems in a growing consumer products environment.

  • Collaborative culture that values transparency, thoughtful feedback, initiative, and professional development.

  • Commitment to providing reasonable accommodations during the application process and employment.

  • Equal opportunity employer committed to considering qualified applicants fairly and without discrimination.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Research Engineering Manager, STEM based in Brazil.

As a Research Engineering Manager, STEM, you will lead a team of research engineers developing advanced datasets, synthetic data systems, and evaluation benchmarks for next-generation AI models. Working at the intersection of machine learning research and engineering, you will collaborate closely with research scientists and leading AI laboratories to improve model capabilities in coding and advanced STEM reasoning. You will oversee the design and implementation of scalable data generation pipelines, rigorous evaluation methodologies, and reinforcement learning environments. Alongside managing and developing your team, you will remain deeply involved in technical execution, contributing directly to complex engineering challenges and research decisions. You will also help define research priorities, establish quality standards, and ensure that experimental results are reliable, reproducible, and meaningful. This is an opportunity to influence the direction of frontier AI research while delivering measurable improvements to advanced AI systems.

lists.content:
Lead the research engineering function responsible for developing high-quality synthetic datasets, reinforcement learning environments, and advanced evaluation benchmarks. You will combine technical leadership, people management, and hands-on research engineering to ensure that projects deliver scientifically rigorous results and measurable improvements in model performance.

  • Build, manage, and develop a high-performing team of research engineers, defining hiring profiles, leading recruitment, and selecting professionals with strong research judgment and engineering expertise.

  • Establish the team's operating structure, including project prioritization, planning, experiment reviews, technical documentation, and clear ownership of deliverables.

  • Coach engineers on experimental design, software quality, research methodology, and technical communication while providing regular feedback and conducting performance evaluations.

  • Define and maintain engineering standards for evaluation methodologies, data quality, and reproducibility, ensuring that datasets and experiments can be regenerated from documented code, configurations, and random seeds.

  • Partner with research scientists to translate research hypotheses into structured experiments, including baseline selection, ablation studies, evaluation criteria, and measurable success outcomes.

  • Contribute independent research ideas and help establish the team's technical and scientific priorities.

  • Translate research prototypes into scalable production systems while preserving their original scientific objectives.

  • Design and oversee synthetic data pipelines covering generation, verification, filtering, deduplication, and versioning through programmatic generators, LLM-based generation, automated verification, and expert review.

  • Evaluate synthetic data quality through fine-tuning and reinforcement learning experiments, measuring how factors such as difficulty, diversity, correctness, and coverage influence model performance.

  • Develop robust quality assurance systems using gold datasets, LLM-judge calibration, expert annotations, sampling audits, and agreement metrics.

  • Identify capability gaps in existing AI models and develop new benchmarks and evaluation methods to measure areas not adequately covered by current assessments.

  • Own benchmark methodology end to end, including task taxonomies, difficulty calibration, grading systems, contamination controls, held-out datasets, and statistical confidence intervals.

  • Build and maintain evaluation harnesses, including agent-based and sandboxed execution evaluations, ensuring deterministic, reproducible, and trustworthy results.

  • Assess experimental findings and determine whether observed model improvements represent statistically meaningful gains or measurement noise.

  • Collaborate with research scientists to publish datasets, benchmarks, and research findings at leading conferences such as NeurIPS, ICML, and ICLR.

  • Remain hands-on with complex technical work, dedicating at least one-third of your time to coding, prototyping, debugging, and improving critical research infrastructure.

  • Serve as the technical reference for complex methodology and engineering challenges, including verifier disagreements, evaluation inconsistencies, and data quality issues.

  • Act as a technical counterpart to researchers at leading AI laboratories, defining project requirements, acceptance criteria, and communicating results and technical trade-offs.

  • Coordinate with strategic project leads, delivery teams, and engineering partners to translate research advancements into client solutions and scalable platforms.

    • Requirements:

    You are an accomplished research engineering leader with extensive experience in machine learning, synthetic data generation, and AI evaluation systems. You combine strong technical expertise with proven people management capabilities and a rigorous scientific mindset. You are comfortable leading research teams while remaining actively involved in engineering implementation, experimental design, and technical decision-making.

  • At least 8 years of hands-on experience in machine learning or research engineering, including at least 5 years in industry.

  • At least 3 years of direct management experience leading research engineers, machine learning engineers, or research teams, including hiring and performance management.

  • Proven experience building and managing synthetic or curated data pipelines in production, with measurable impact on model training and performance.

  • Strong understanding of synthetic data generation, verification, filtering, and quality assessment methodologies.

  • Demonstrated experience designing and delivering LLM evaluations or benchmarks used by other teams or organizations to make model development decisions.

  • Deep understanding of evaluation challenges, including data contamination, benchmark saturation, judge bias, inter-annotator agreement, statistical variance, and confidence intervals.

  • Strong experimental design skills, including the ability to define meaningful baselines, plan ablation studies, and distinguish genuine performance improvements from statistical noise.

  • Advanced Python programming skills and production experience with PyTorch or JAX.

  • Working knowledge of modern AI post-training methodologies, including Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards.

  • Experience with distributed data processing and large-scale evaluation or training workloads using technologies such as Ray, Spark, or Kubernetes.

  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, particularly AWS or GCP.

  • Ability to establish technical direction, define research priorities, and guide a team beyond simply executing an existing roadmap.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical findings to research scientists, engineering teams, and non-specialist stakeholders.

  • Daily experience using AI-powered coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot, with the ability to critically evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs.

  • Master's or PhD degree in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Statistics, or a closely related discipline. A PhD is preferred, although exceptional equivalent research experience will also be considered.

    • Strongly Preferred:

  • Previous experience at a frontier AI laboratory or leading industry research organization, particularly in post-training data, model evaluation, or reward modeling.

  • Experience contributing to or developing publicly recognized benchmarks or datasets used by the research community.

    • Nice to Have:

  • First-author research publications at leading conferences or journals, including NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, or EMNLP.

  • Experience designing reinforcement learning environments and verifiers for agentic tasks, including coding agents, tool use, computer use, and long-horizon workflows.

  • Knowledge of data valuation and attribution methodologies to measure the contribution of individual data segments to model performance.

  • Advanced expertise in a STEM discipline such as mathematics, physics, chemistry, or biology.

  • Experience managing technical leads or other managers, or coordinating multiple concurrent research programs.

  • Experience directing large expert networks through detailed specifications, evaluation rubrics, and rapid feedback processes.

    • Benefits:

  • Opportunity to work directly with leading AI laboratories and enterprises on advanced model development, post-training, evaluation, and synthetic data initiatives.

  • Direct involvement in building high-impact datasets, reinforcement learning environments, and innovative benchmarks for next-generation AI systems.

  • Opportunity to influence how frontier AI models are evaluated and how progress in coding and STEM reasoning is measured.

  • High level of autonomy and ownership in a fast-moving, research-driven environment.

  • Collaboration with experienced AI researchers and technology professionals from leading organizations such as Google, Meta, and Amazon.

  • Opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research and publish findings at prestigious conferences, including ICLR, ICML, and NeurIPS.

  • Exposure to enterprise AI applications, translating frontier research innovations into practical business solutions.

  • Opportunity to work at the forefront of AI innovation in a dynamic, startup-paced environment.

  • Inclusive and diverse working culture that values professional growth, authenticity, and collaboration.

As a RevOps & Systems Specialist, you will help keep the systems, processes, and automations powering multiple B2B sales operations running smoothly. You will serve as the first point of contact for operational requests, manage onboarding and offboarding processes, and ensure teams have the tools and access they need to perform effectively. Working across CRM platforms, sales engagement tools, productivity systems, and reporting solutions, you will improve workflows and eliminate repetitive manual tasks. You will also support email infrastructure, troubleshoot technical issues, and maintain reliable dashboards for sales teams and leadership. In an AI-first environment, you will use automation and emerging tools to increase efficiency while ensuring every solution is properly tested, documented, and adopted. This remote opportunity is ideal for someone who enjoys solving operational challenges, taking ownership, and making a measurable impact in a fast-paced, collaborative team.

lists.content:
You will support the day-to-day effectiveness of revenue operations by administering key systems, resolving requests, coordinating user access, and building scalable processes. Your work will help ensure that sales teams and internal stakeholders can rely on accurate information, efficient workflows, and well-maintained technology.

  • Request Management & Operational Support

  • Serve as the first point of contact for RevOps requests, assessing priorities and managing incoming operational needs.

  • Resolve straightforward requests independently and translate more complex issues into clearly defined tasks with appropriate follow-up.

  • Provide day-to-day technical and operational support to sales teams and internal stakeholders.

  • Onboarding & Offboarding

  • Manage client and employee onboarding and offboarding processes from start to finish.

  • Coordinate account creation, system access, permissions, tools, communication channels, and reporting configurations.

  • Ensure smooth transitions and consistent access management throughout the employee and client lifecycle.

  • Systems Administration

  • Administer CRM platforms, sales engagement tools, and productivity applications, including user accounts, permissions, fields, and pipelines.

  • Configure and audit CRM environments for new clients, ensuring systems are structured and aligned with operational requirements.

  • Maintain the reliability and organization of the company's go-to-market technology stack.

  • Automation & Workflow Optimization

  • Build, maintain, and improve no-code automations, workflows, and notifications using tools such as Zapier, Make, and HubSpot workflows.

  • Identify repetitive manual processes and implement practical solutions to improve efficiency and consistency.

  • Use AI tools to accelerate operational work while validating the logic, accuracy, and reliability of their outputs.

  • Reporting & Data Management

  • Maintain dashboards and reports used by sales teams and leadership.

  • Support the accuracy, consistency, and accessibility of operational and commercial reporting.

  • Email Infrastructure & IT Support

  • Manage domains, DNS records, email authentication, mailboxes, and email deliverability.

  • Support email infrastructure configurations, including SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.

  • Handle day-to-day IT support requests and user access management.

  • Documentation & Continuous Improvement

  • Create and maintain clear, up-to-date documentation covering systems, workflows, and operational procedures.

  • Ensure that new processes and automations are properly documented and adopted by the teams using them.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate is organized, technically comfortable, and proactive, with hands-on experience supporting revenue or sales operations through CRM administration, automation, and systems management. You should be able to manage multiple requests efficiently, communicate clearly in English, and take ownership of operational tasks from start to finish.

  • At least 2 years of proven experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, or a systems or IT administration role supporting sales teams.

  • Professional bilingual English proficiency, both written and spoken. The interview process is conducted in English.

  • Hands-on CRM administration experience, particularly with HubSpot and Salesforce.

  • Experience building and maintaining no-code automations using tools such as Zapier, Make, or HubSpot workflows.

  • Advanced Google Sheets and/or Microsoft Excel skills.

  • Working knowledge of email infrastructure, including domains, DNS records, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and mailbox configuration.

  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to handle multiple requests and priorities without losing track of details.

  • Clear written communication skills and a consistent approach to documenting processes and completed work.

  • Based in Latin America, with sufficient availability to collaborate during US business hours.

  • A proactive, ownership-oriented mindset and the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with different teams.

    • Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Outreach.io, Salesloft, or other sales engagement platforms.

  • Knowledge of email deliverability, inbox management, and email warm-up practices.

  • Experience administering Google Workspace or Microsoft 365.

  • Familiarity with data enrichment platforms such as Clay.

  • Basic SQL knowledge or experience with Google Apps Script.

  • Regular use of AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to automate workflows and improve productivity.

    • Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation package, including salary, commission, and performance-based bonuses paid in USD.

  • Performance-based salary increases.

  • Quarterly Presidents Club rewards, including trips to destinations such as Las Vegas, Mexico, and Costa Rica for employees who achieve revenue targets.

  • Fully remote-first working environment, with the flexibility to work from a location of your choice.

  • Coworking space expenses covered.

  • Necessary work equipment provided.

  • Open vacation policy, allowing employees to take time off while maintaining their performance goals.

  • Unlimited professional development budget, covering 100% of eligible books, courses, conferences, and other learning opportunities.

  • Health reimbursement.

  • Fitness stipend.

  • Opportunities for professional growth and development within a collaborative, international team.

  • A culture built around ownership, accountability, customer success, continuous improvement, and results.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a RevOps Data Infrastructure Engineer based in Brazil.

We are seeking a skilled RevOps Data Infrastructure Engineer to build and maintain a centralized, scalable data platform supporting revenue operations across multiple B2B clients. In this role, you will take ownership of the data warehouse, ingestion pipelines, and data infrastructure powering business intelligence, reporting, and automation. You will integrate information from different CRM and sales engagement platforms, transforming fragmented data into reliable, actionable insights. Working closely with Revenue Operations teams, you will replace manual processes with robust, automated solutions and ensure consistent data quality across environments. This is an AI-first, remote opportunity for a technically strong professional who values ownership, documentation, continuous improvement, and measurable business impact.

lists.content:
As a RevOps Data Infrastructure Engineer, you will own the architecture, development, and continuous improvement of the data infrastructure supporting revenue operations. You will ensure that data from multiple client systems is accurately integrated, accessible, and structured to support reporting, automation, and informed decision-making.

  • Data Warehouse Management: Own, maintain, and continuously evolve the cloud data warehouse, including its architecture and data models.

  • Data Pipeline Development: Build, operate, and monitor data ingestion pipelines connecting CRMs, sales engagement platforms, and other business systems, including sources without native integrations.

  • Process Automation: Replace fragile spreadsheet-based workflows with reliable, scalable, warehouse-driven solutions.

  • Reporting and Alerts: Develop and maintain the data infrastructure behind dashboards, business reports, automated notifications, and operational alerts.

  • Data Quality Management: Monitor data integrity, identify inconsistencies, troubleshoot issues, and implement solutions at their source to maintain reliable datasets.

  • Scalability and Standardization: Transform successful client-specific solutions into standardized processes that can be replicated across multiple environments.

  • Infrastructure Optimization: Manage data platform access, performance, and costs while ensuring the infrastructure remains efficient and scalable.

  • Technical Documentation: Create and maintain clear technical documentation, processes, and guidelines to facilitate knowledge sharing and consistent implementation.

  • AI-Driven Development: Leverage AI-powered tools to accelerate development while reviewing and validating generated outputs to ensure technical accuracy and reliability.

  • Continuous Improvement: Ensure that completed projects are properly documented, implemented, and actively adopted by the teams relying on them.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines strong data engineering expertise with a solid understanding of revenue operations, CRM ecosystems, and business intelligence. You should be comfortable managing complex data environments, troubleshooting integrations, and building scalable solutions independently. Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and excellent English communication skills are essential.

  • At least 3 years of proven experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a technical Revenue Operations (RevOps) or Business Operations (BizOps) role.

  • Strong proficiency in SQL and hands-on experience working with cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery, Snowflake, or Amazon Redshift.

  • Experience with data modeling tools such as Dataform or dbt and ELT platforms such as Fivetran.

  • Ability to build, maintain, and troubleshoot data pipelines, including diagnosing and resolving integration failures.

  • Scripting experience using JavaScript, Google Apps Script, Python, or similar technologies.

  • Good understanding of CRM and sales data ecosystems, particularly HubSpot and Salesforce.

  • Strong commitment to data quality, with the ability to validate datasets, verify calculations, and identify inconsistencies before information reaches stakeholders.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with a proactive approach to technical challenges.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.

  • Excellent written and spoken English proficiency, as interviews and professional communication are conducted in English.

  • Based in Latin America, with sufficient availability to collaborate during U.S. business hours.

  • Ability to work autonomously, take ownership of projects, and document technical solutions clearly.

    • Nice to Have:

  • Experience working with HubSpot, Salesforce, or Outreach data and APIs.

  • Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and business intelligence tools such as Looker Studio.

  • Knowledge of Git and version control practices.

  • Experience migrating spreadsheet-based workflows into structured data warehouses and automated processes.

  • Regular use of AI-powered development tools such as Claude, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot to improve productivity and accelerate engineering workflows.

  • Previous experience supporting revenue operations or sales development teams in multi-client environments.

    • Benefits:

  • Competitive USD Compensation: Receive an attractive compensation package including a competitive base salary, commissions, and performance-based bonuses.

  • Performance-Based Salary Increases: Benefit from opportunities for compensation growth based on individual results and achievements.

  • Presidents Club Rewards: Top performers who achieve their revenue targets can earn quarterly trips to exciting destinations such as Las Vegas, Mexico, and Costa Rica, with opportunities for team activities and recognition.

  • Fully Remote Work: Enjoy the flexibility to work from anywhere, with coworking space expenses covered and the equipment needed to perform your role.

  • Flexible Vacation Policy: Take time off when needed through an open vacation policy, while maintaining agreed performance objectives.

  • Unlimited Professional Development: Access an unlimited development budget covering 100% of eligible expenses for books, courses, conferences, and other learning opportunities.

  • Health Reimbursement: Receive additional support for healthcare-related expenses.

  • Fitness Stipend: Benefit from financial support for fitness and wellness activities.

  • Results-Oriented Culture: Work in an environment that values ownership, accountability, excellence, and tangible business impact.

  • Collaborative Team Environment: Join a team-oriented culture that encourages open communication, continuous learning, constructive feedback, and shared success.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sales Coordinator - Advertising Company based in Brazil.

We are looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented Sales Coordinator to support the daily operations of a dynamic advertising sales team. In this role, you will work closely with Account Executives to coordinate the entire sales process, from proposal preparation and contract administration to campaign reporting and client support. You will play a key role in ensuring that sales activities run efficiently, deadlines are met, and client expectations are consistently exceeded. Working across multiple departments, you will help align campaign schedules, advertising inventory, and client deliverables. This position offers hands-on exposure to sales operations, account management, and the outdoor advertising industry, with opportunities to develop your skills and take on greater responsibilities over time.

lists.content:
As a Sales Coordinator, you will provide essential administrative and operational support to the sales team, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and seamless coordination throughout the sales and campaign lifecycle.

  • Collaborate with Account Executives to prepare, organize, and submit accurate, client-focused proposals and presentations.

  • Coordinate RFP and proposal timelines, ensuring all required materials are collected and delivered ahead of deadlines.

  • Gather information from internal teams, including advertising inventory availability, specifications, and creative assets.

  • Maintain and update proposal templates, pricing information, and content libraries.

  • Manage the contract administration process, from document creation to execution, ensuring accuracy and timely completion.

  • Enter and maintain sales-related information, client records, and campaign details in CMS and CRM systems.

  • Prepare and process documentation, forms, and administrative records related to sales agreements and client accounts.

  • Create and deliver Proof of Performance (POP) reports to demonstrate campaign results and advertising effectiveness.

  • Respond promptly and professionally to client inquiries, information requests, and support needs.

  • Coordinate with marketing, creative, inventory, operations, and real estate teams to align campaign schedules with asset availability.

  • Monitor campaign timelines and deliverables to ensure they meet client expectations.

  • Assist the sales team with reporting, sales performance tracking, and key business metrics.

  • Provide ongoing administrative support to Account Executives throughout the sales and client management process.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate is a proactive, dependable, and detail-oriented professional with excellent organizational and communication skills. You should be comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment, working with digital systems, and collaborating with different teams while maintaining a high standard of accuracy.

  • Associate's degree or higher in a relevant field.

  • Professional proficiency in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Excellent organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, competing priorities, and tight deadlines effectively.

  • Comfortable with data entry and working with Content Management Systems (CMS) and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platforms.

  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues and management while also working independently.

  • Reliable, proactive, and responsive approach to client communication and internal coordination.

  • Strong work ethic, accountability, and willingness to take ownership of responsibilities.

  • Creative problem-solving skills and the ability to approach complex business challenges thoughtfully.

  • Enthusiasm for building professional relationships and interacting with new people.

    • Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline.

  • Previous experience in sales coordination, sales support, account administration, or a similar position.

  • Experience preparing proposals, managing contracts, or producing client-facing reports.

  • Interest in real estate development, advertising, or sales operations.

  • Previous exposure to billboard or outdoor advertising is an advantage but not required.

    • Benefits:

  • Monthly compensation of USD 1,100.

  • Full-time contractor engagement.

  • Fully remote working arrangement.

  • Opportunity to work with a team operating across major advertising markets in the United States.

  • Hands-on exposure to sales, operations, campaign management, and client relationships.

  • Opportunities for professional development and increased responsibilities as you grow within the team.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sales Development Representative (SDR) based in Brazil.

We are seeking a proactive, research-driven Sales Development Representative to build qualified sales pipeline for an innovative enterprise AI governance business. In this fully remote contractor role, you will identify and engage senior decision-makers across insurance, healthcare, financial services, and fintech organizations. You will lead targeted outbound campaigns through email, LinkedIn, and phone, creating personalized messaging around technical topics such as AI infrastructure, runtime governance, and usage control. Working directly with company founders and an Enterprise Account Executive, you will help refine prospecting strategies and strengthen the sales approach. This is an opportunity to join an early-stage technology environment, contribute to enterprise growth, and engage with organizations navigating the challenges of responsible AI adoption.

lists.content:
• Research target enterprise accounts across insurance, healthcare, financial services, and fintech sectors to identify relevant prospects and decision-makers.

  • Identify and engage senior IT and engineering leaders, including CIOs, CTOs, VPs and Heads of Engineering, AI/Data leaders, and AI platform decision-makers.

  • Use prospecting and data-enrichment tools to develop, organize, and manage targeted lead lists.

  • Execute multi-channel outbound campaigns through email, LinkedIn, and phone to generate qualified sales meetings.

  • Develop personalized, relevant outreach that communicates complex technical topics, including AI infrastructure, model access and routing, usage and cost management, and runtime governance.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date prospect information, activity records, and pipeline data in HubSpot or a similar CRM.

  • Collaborate directly with founders to test and improve sales messaging, targeting strategies, and prospect lists.

  • Support the Enterprise Account Executive by building relationships and generating pipeline with key decision-makers at target accounts.

  • Track outreach performance and contribute to a consistent monthly flow of qualified meetings.

    • Requirements

  • At least 2 years of experience in B2B outbound sales or sales development, ideally selling software to mid-market or enterprise organizations in the US.

  • Advanced professional proficiency in written and spoken English, with the confidence to communicate effectively with US-based executives.

  • Hands-on experience using HubSpot or a comparable CRM platform.

  • Practical experience with prospecting, lead generation, and data-enrichment tools.

  • Familiarity with AI-powered tools such as ChatGPT or Claude for research, prospecting, and sales communication.

  • Strong research, writing, and communication skills, with the ability to create personalized outreach around technical products and business challenges.

  • Curiosity about technology and the ability to understand and communicate concepts related to AI infrastructure, cloud platforms, data, and governance.

  • Highly organized, self-directed, and comfortable taking initiative in a small, early-stage startup environment with limited supervision.

  • Availability to work during US Eastern business hours.

  • Must be based in Latin America. Applicants should submit their CV in English.

    • Nice to have:

  • Experience selling developer tools, cloud solutions, data platforms, cybersecurity products, or AI technologies.

  • Previous experience prospecting or selling into insurance, healthcare, or financial services organizations.

  • Experience working in an early-stage or fast-growing startup.

    • Benefits

  • 100% remote contractor position.

  • Open to candidates residing in Latin America, including Brazil.

  • Opportunity to work directly with company founders and an Enterprise Account Executive.

  • Exposure to enterprise AI governance, infrastructure, and emerging technology markets.

  • Opportunity to contribute to pipeline development and enterprise sales strategy in an early-stage technology business.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sales Representative based in Brazil.

We are looking for a results-driven Sales Representative to lead full-cycle B2B sales and drive new client acquisition across the US HVAC market. In this role, you will manage the entire sales process, from high-volume outbound prospecting and lead qualification to discovery calls, solution presentations, negotiations, and closing recurring service agreements. You will promote digital marketing solutions, including SEO, Google Ads, and conversion-focused website design, helping businesses strengthen their online visibility and generate qualified leads. Working directly with company leadership, you will build a consistent sales pipeline, develop strong relationships with business owners, and contribute to recurring revenue growth. This is an opportunity for an independent and resilient sales professional who thrives in a performance-driven remote environment and enjoys taking ownership of measurable business results.

lists.content:
As a Sales Representative, you will take ownership of the complete B2B sales cycle, identifying new business opportunities, engaging prospective clients, presenting tailored marketing solutions, and closing recurring service agreements. You will also maintain accurate sales records, monitor performance indicators, and continuously improve prospecting and conversion strategies.

  • Outbound Prospecting and Pipeline Generation:

  • Conduct approximately 60–80 targeted outbound calls per day after the initial ramp-up period, focusing on HVAC business owners across the United States.

  • Generate new opportunities through cold calling, email sequences, LinkedIn outreach, and other approved prospecting channels.

  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads based on business objectives, marketing challenges, decision-making authority, budget, and service suitability.

  • Schedule and conduct approximately 5–8 qualified sales meetings per week to identify business needs and assess existing digital marketing performance.

  • Consultative Selling and Deal Closing:

  • Present tailored digital marketing solutions, including SEO, Google Ads management, and conversion-focused website design.

  • Clearly communicate the potential return on investment of proposed solutions, focusing on lead generation and customer acquisition without making unsupported guarantees.

  • Lead discovery conversations, address prospect objections, negotiate contract terms, and independently close recurring monthly service agreements.

  • Work toward a target qualified-opportunity close rate of approximately 25% and around $6,000 USD in new monthly recurring revenue after the ramp-up period.

  • Coordinate signed agreements, initial payment arrangements, and structured client handoffs to the service delivery team.

  • CRM Management and Sales Forecasting:

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of calls, follow-up tasks, communications, and deal stages in Close CRM.

  • Follow established multichannel follow-up sequences to maintain prospect engagement and improve conversion opportunities.

  • Track daily activity metrics, meeting conversion rates, and pipeline performance.

  • Prepare weekly sales updates and revenue forecasts for direct review by company leadership.

  • Analyze prospect feedback and common objections to improve sales scripts, qualification criteria, and closing strategies.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate is an experienced B2B sales professional with a proven ability to generate opportunities through outbound prospecting and independently close deals with US-based business owners. You should combine strong communication and negotiation skills with disciplined CRM management, resilience, and a consistent focus on sales performance.

  • At least 3 years of proven full-cycle B2B sales experience, including cold outbound prospecting, discovery calls, virtual presentations, negotiations, and independently closing deals.

  • Demonstrated experience selling directly to US business owners, founders, or decision-makers within small and midsize businesses.

  • Strong cold-calling and consultative selling skills, including the ability to initiate natural conversations, navigate gatekeepers, handle objections, and close recurring service agreements.

  • Practical experience managing sales pipelines through a modern CRM platform, with Close CRM experience preferred.

  • A proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales activity and revenue targets.

  • High accountability, resilience, and motivation to succeed in a high-volume outbound sales environment.

  • Openness to direct feedback and coaching from executive leadership, with a strong commitment to continuous improvement.

  • Native-level or equivalent advanced English proficiency (C1/C2), with excellent written and spoken communication skills for confident, unscripted conversations with US business owners.

  • Full availability to work Monday through Friday, from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM US Eastern Time, including a one-hour break.

  • A reliable remote working setup, including a high-performance computer, HD webcam, professional noise-canceling headset, and high-speed internet connection.

  • Ability to maintain a quiet, professional home office environment and work independently.

As a Security Engineering Manager, you will lead the development and execution of a comprehensive security strategy in a technology-driven environment focused on innovation and large-scale digital platforms. You will combine technical leadership, team development, and hands-on security expertise to strengthen information security, data governance, and organizational resilience. From offensive security and vulnerability management to cloud security and incident response, you will oversee critical initiatives while helping engineering teams integrate security into their development processes. You will also play a key role in addressing emerging risks associated with artificial intelligence and sensitive data. lists.content:
You will lead the security engineering team and oversee the execution of the security roadmap, balancing governance, offensive security, and incident response initiatives. Acting as both a technical reference and strategic partner, you will work closely with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to identify risks, improve security maturity, and ensure that technical decisions support organizational objectives.

  • Manage the team's daily activities, allocate responsibilities according to individual experience, monitor delivery, and remove technical or organizational blockers.

  • Mentor team members, support individual development plans, and encourage professional growth and technical excellence.

  • Translate the security roadmap into actionable plans, balancing governance, offensive security, and incident response priorities.

  • Implement, maintain, and continuously improve security control programs based on recognized frameworks such as NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, and CIS Controls v8.

  • Support internal and external audits, regulatory compliance activities, and the formalization of security controls.

  • Lead penetration testing initiatives with internal teams and external partners, defining schedules, coordinating scope, and ensuring execution quality.

  • Help engineering teams adopt shift-left security practices, integrating security into CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, containers, and cloud environments.

  • Support the implementation and management of security solutions involving Cloudflare WAF, AWS, GCP, and Azure.

  • Oversee vulnerability management and use CSPM platforms such as Wiz, alongside SAST and SCA tools, to investigate exposed tokens, vulnerable public APIs, misconfigured storage buckets, and other security risks.

  • Use security telemetry and technical findings to strengthen organizational risk assessments and prioritization.

  • Plan and facilitate tabletop exercises with technical and business teams to improve incident preparedness and response capabilities.

  • Monitor security performance indicators, prepare management reports, and communicate progress and risks to leadership.

  • Build strong relationships with engineering stakeholders, providing proactive and consultative guidance to resolve incidents and establish effective remediation plans.

  • Escalate significant risks and ensure they are properly documented, communicated, and addressed through established governance processes.

  • Leverage AI tools to improve productivity, automate workflows, identify vulnerabilities, support penetration testing, and solve complex technical problems.

  • Develop reports and dashboards using Looker and other data visualization tools, translating technical findings into clear business insights for technical and executive audiences.

  • Manage relationships with penetration testing partners and security vendors, ensuring alignment on scope, schedules, and deliverables.
