  • Bachelor's degree in Technology, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field.

  • Previous experience leading or coordinating technical teams.

  • Proven technical experience in information security, preferably within Yellow Team or Red Team environments.

  • Strong knowledge of security control frameworks, particularly NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, and/or CIS Controls v8.

  • Practical experience in offensive security, including penetration testing, Red Team activities, vulnerability exploitation, and MITRE ATT&CK.

  • Basic to intermediate SQL skills for auditing data lakes and databases, tracking privileges, identifying personally identifiable information (PII), and detecting logical vulnerabilities.

  • Hands-on DevSecOps experience, including:

  • Security integration into CI/CD pipelines.

  • SAST, DAST, and SCA tools.

  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) security.

  • Container security and cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, and GCP.

  • Experience with data discovery and classification, including identifying PII in relational and non-relational databases and business intelligence platforms such as Metabase.

  • Experience with Data Loss Prevention (DLP) engineering and network or traffic security solutions, such as Zscaler, proxies, or CASB platforms.

  • Practical use of AI tools to develop automations and dashboards, extract metrics, proactively identify vulnerabilities, conduct penetration testing, and solve technical problems.

As a Senior Accountant, you will play a key role in maintaining accurate financial records and supporting the accounting operations of a rapidly growing U.S. legal services organization. You will oversee general ledger activities, multi-entity financial reporting, and monthly and annual closing processes. Working closely with the Controller and cross-functional teams, you will help ensure reliable, GAAP-compliant financial statements and provide meaningful financial insights to leadership. You will also contribute to strengthening internal controls, improving accounting procedures, and supporting budgeting and forecasting activities. This remote opportunity is suited to a detail-oriented professional who can manage complex accounting responsibilities with autonomy, integrity, and a strong commitment to accuracy.

lists.content:
You will oversee core accounting activities across multiple entities, ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and timely delivery of financial information. Reporting directly to the Controller, you will collaborate with internal departments and external stakeholders while helping improve accounting processes and financial controls.

  • Prepare and consolidate monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements across multiple entities.

  • Deliver consolidated financial close packages to leadership in accordance with established reporting calendars.

  • Manage general ledger activities and ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of financial records.

  • Execute and support monthly and year-end closing processes, including account reconciliations and supporting schedules.

  • Prepare weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports for management and other stakeholders.

  • Establish, document, and maintain internal controls, accounting policies, and procedures.

  • Contribute to annual budgeting and quarterly forecasting processes.

  • Prepare supporting financial schedules and explain actual results against budgets and forecasts.

  • Research accounting matters and ensure compliance with U.S. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).

  • Support the adoption and implementation of new accounting standards when required.

  • Analyze cost variances and provide relevant financial insights.

  • Work with Operations, Payroll, Accounting, leadership, external auditors, and financial institutions to investigate and resolve accounting issues.

  • Provide trained cross-functional coverage for Billing, Cash Application, and Accounts Payable during absences and peak periods.

  • Maintain appropriate segregation of duties, ensuring payroll processing remains under the responsibility of the Accounting Manager.

  • Identify opportunities to improve accounting workflows, internal controls, reporting accuracy, and operational efficiency.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate is an experienced accounting professional with strong technical knowledge of U.S. GAAP and proven experience managing financial reporting and close processes in a multi-entity environment. You should be comfortable working independently, communicating fluently in English with U.S. stakeholders, and managing responsibilities in a fast-paced organization.

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • At least 5 years of progressively responsible accounting experience.

  • Previous public accounting experience or equivalent experience managing financial close processes within a multi-entity corporate accounting environment.

  • Advanced knowledge of U.S. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).

  • Demonstrated experience in general ledger accounting, account reconciliations, financial reporting, and month-end closing.

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup and index functions, and formula-driven reconciliations involving large datasets.

  • Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively with Operations, Payroll, leadership, and external stakeholders.

  • Strong attention to detail and consistent follow-through on commitments.

  • High standards of integrity, discretion, and professionalism.

  • Fluent English at C1 level or higher, with the ability to participate in meetings, prepare written communications, and interact confidently with U.S.-based stakeholders.

  • Must currently reside in Brazil.

  • Ability to work remotely with autonomy, accountability, and consistent availability.

    • Preferred Qualifications:

  • Active Certified Public Accountant (CPA) license or current CPA candidacy.

  • Hands-on experience with NetSuite in a multi-entity environment.

  • Previous public accounting experience.

  • Experience supporting a U.S.-based organization.

  • Background in a rapidly growing or high-volume accounting operation.

    • Technical Requirements:

  • High-performance computer or notebook.

  • Intel Core i5 or i7 processor, Apple M1 or higher, or equivalent.

  • Minimum of 12 GB RAM.

  • Stable high-speed internet connection, with a recommended minimum of 50 Mbps download and upload speeds.

  • Professional headset.

  • Two monitors.

  • Quiet, private, and structured remote-working environment.

    • Benefits:

  • Remote work arrangement for candidates currently residing in Brazil.

  • Opportunity to support the accounting operations of a growing U.S.-based organization.

  • Direct reporting relationship with the Controller.

  • Exposure to complex, multi-entity accounting operations and U.S. GAAP financial reporting.

  • Opportunity to contribute to process improvements, internal controls, and financial reporting initiatives.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Adobe Launch and Web SDK Engineer – Talent Connection based in Brazil.

As a Senior Adobe Launch and Web SDK Engineer, you will play a key role in optimizing digital analytics implementations and ensuring privacy-compliant data collection across enterprise platforms. You will leverage your expertise in Adobe Tags (formerly Adobe Launch), Adobe Web SDK, and consent management technologies to modernize tracking infrastructures and improve data accuracy. A major focus will be migrating tag management and consent solutions from TrustArc to OneTrust while maintaining reliable Adobe Analytics functionality. You will collaborate with technical teams, business stakeholders, and international clients to design, implement, and validate effective solutions. You will also contribute to technical best practices through code reviews, developer mentoring, and Agile collaboration. This opportunity offers significant technical ownership, autonomy, and the chance to work on impactful digital transformation initiatives within a globally distributed environment.

lists.content:
• Assess existing tag management and consent management implementations, identifying improvement opportunities and planning migrations from TrustArc to OneTrust.
  • Lead and execute end-to-end migration activities, including platform configuration, implementation, validation, cutover, and decommissioning of legacy solutions.
  • Configure OneTrust consent management capabilities, including cookie categories, consent banners, and consent signals, ensuring appropriate integration with Adobe Tags.
  • Implement consent-based tagging conditions to ensure tracking scripts and tags are triggered according to users' privacy preferences.
  • Update and maintain Adobe Tags rules and data elements, auditing cookies, scripts, and tracking configurations to ensure all required analytics functionality is preserved during migration.
  • Configure and maintain Adobe Experience Platform Data Collection (Adobe Tags, formerly Adobe Launch) and Adobe Web SDK implementations.
  • Validate and troubleshoot tagging and consent behavior before and after migrations using Adobe Experience Platform Debugger, Adobe Assurance, and browser developer tools.
  • Administer Adobe Analytics report suites, including processing rules, eVars, props, events, and classifications, while developing reports and insights through Analysis Workspace.
  • Ensure digital analytics implementations maintain data accuracy, consistency, and compliance with applicable privacy requirements.
  • Collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders to communicate implementation decisions, resolve issues, and coordinate project activities.
  • Mentor developers, lead code reviews, and contribute to technical knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure effective project delivery.
  • Take part in technical interview initiatives by evaluating candidates for assigned and other project teams, helping identify qualified professionals and support team growth.

    • Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Hands-on experience migrating tag management and consent management solutions from TrustArc to OneTrust.
  • Strong experience configuring Adobe Experience Platform Data Collection, including Adobe Tags (formerly Adobe Launch), and Adobe Web SDK.
  • Proven experience configuring OneTrust consent management functionalities, particularly cookie categories, consent banners, and consent signals.
  • At least 3 years of professional JavaScript experience, including data layer development, tagging, and digital analytics implementations.
  • Solid experience administering Adobe Analytics report suites, including processing rules, eVars, props, events, and classifications.
  • Practical experience developing reports and analyzing digital performance data using Adobe Analytics Analysis Workspace.
  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills using Adobe Experience Platform Debugger, Adobe Assurance, and browser developer tools.
  • Working knowledge of data collection and privacy regulations, particularly GDPR and CCPA, and their implications for digital tracking and consent management.
  • Understanding of consent-driven data collection and the integration of privacy preferences with analytics and marketing technologies.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with excellent attention to detail and a commitment to data quality.
  • Experience mentoring developers, conducting code reviews, and promoting technical best practices.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical responsibilities, and collaborate effectively within distributed, multicultural teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency (C1–C2 preferred), as the role involves working with US-based clients and requires confident communication in professional meetings and technical discussions.

    • Benefits:

  • Competitive salary paid in USD.
  • Fully remote working arrangement across Latin America.
  • Access to coworking spaces throughout the region for those who prefer occasional in-person collaboration.
  • Paid time off in accordance with the employment regulations of your country, with full salary.
  • Paid national public holidays.
  • Sick leave provisions.
  • Annual refundable allowance to support health and personal well-being expenses.
  • Additional day off to celebrate your birthday.
  • Dedicated People Care team providing support with well-being, time off, and employee needs.
  • Autonomous working environment with genuine ownership and minimal micromanagement.
  • Opportunities to collaborate with international clients and experienced technology professionals.
  • Exposure to modern digital analytics, privacy, and consent management technologies.
  • Opportunities for professional development, technical mentoring, and participation in engineering initiatives.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Agentic AI Engineer based in Brazil.

We are looking for an experienced AI engineer to design and build intelligent, agent-driven experiences for an enterprise governance knowledge platform. In this role, you will work at the intersection of Generative AI, enterprise search, content architecture, and Microsoft 365 technologies. You will develop and configure AI agents that can understand complex documentation, deliver reliable answers, and adapt to the needs of different user groups. A strong focus will be placed on retrieval accuracy, citation integrity, information security, and scalable platform design. Working closely with engineering, product, and governance stakeholders, you will help turn large document ecosystems into accessible, trusted knowledge. This is an opportunity to contribute to advanced AI solutions in a collaborative, international environment.

lists.content:
• Collaborate with program leads, governance document authors, and engineering teams to understand platform requirements, user needs, and expected agent behavior.

  • Analyze governance documentation, technical specifications, and business requirements to create accurate, well-structured, and properly cited agent configurations.

  • Design, configure, and maintain declarative and custom AI agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft 365 Copilot, grounded in SharePoint libraries and other approved knowledge sources.

  • Develop and maintain persona-based agent experiences tailored to commercial, functional, engineering, customer, and auditor audiences.

  • Implement and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) strategies to improve answer accuracy, citation reliability, security, and consistency.

  • Extend Copilot capabilities where needed through Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Graph connectors, and related technologies.

  • Build and maintain content architectures, metadata, taxonomies, document chunking, and tagging strategies to support effective AI retrieval and consumption.

  • Tune search relevance and assess agent quality through testing, performance measures, adoption data, and user feedback.

  • Identify, document, and report agent quality issues, providing evidence, logs, and practical recommendations for remediation.

  • Configure agent instructions, topics, actions, and knowledge sources to ensure reliable responses across different audiences and use cases.

  • Enable on-demand generation of PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and PDF documents using approved content and brand templates.

  • Apply Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels, access permissions, and Data Loss Prevention (DLP) controls to ensure users only access information they are authorized to see.

  • Maintain reusable agent configurations, prompts, runbooks, technical documentation, and traceable configuration artifacts in line with governance and audit requirements.

  • Coordinate with product, engineering, and governance stakeholders to anticipate platform changes, clarify requirements, review designs, and validate implementations.

  • Proactively identify deployment risks, escalate critical issues, and recommend mitigation strategies to maintain quality and compliance.

  • Participate in Agile delivery activities, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 3 years of relevant professional experience.

  • Strong background in software, platform, and data solution development, including delivering AI and Large Language Model (LLM) solutions into production.

  • Hands-on experience with Azure AI and Machine Learning services.

  • Practical experience developing Generative AI applications and implementing RAG solutions.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Copilot Studio for building, configuring, and maintaining AI agents.

  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft SharePoint for enterprise content and document management.

  • Experience with database development and the management of structured and unstructured data.

  • Understanding of information architecture, content organization, and data modeling principles.

  • Familiarity with Agile delivery practices and the ability to communicate effectively across distributed teams and multi-vendor stakeholder groups.

  • Professional proficiency in English at C1 level.

  • Proactive, accountable, and analytical approach to problem-solving, with strong collaboration and communication skills.

  • Nice to have: Experience with AWS Bedrock, Amazon Kendra, or broader AWS cloud infrastructure.

  • Nice to have: Experience with Azure AI Search and Azure OpenAI Service for intelligent search and Generative AI applications.

  • Nice to have: Knowledge of DLP practices and enterprise information security.

  • Nice to have: Familiarity with GxP compliance standards or experience in healthcare and other regulated industries.

  • Nice to have: Knowledge of knowledge graphs and methods for connecting structured information.

  • Nice to have: Experience with LangChain and prompt engineering for LLM-powered applications.

  • Nice to have: Familiarity with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Graph API, and Microsoft Graph Data Connect.

  • Nice to have: Experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Automate, and Microsoft Purview for workflow automation, governance, and data protection.

  • Nice to have: Front-end development experience with ReactJS, TypeScript, or SharePoint Framework (SPFx).

  • Nice to have: Relevant professional certifications in AI, cloud technologies, or related disciplines.

    • Benefits:

  • Opportunity to contribute to international projects for leading global brands.

  • Collaboration with diverse, highly skilled teams across different locations.

  • Healthcare benefits.

  • Employee financial programs.

  • Paid time off and sick leave.

  • Upskilling and reskilling opportunities, including professional certification courses.

  • Unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning and more than 22,000 courses.

  • Global career development opportunities.

  • Volunteer and community involvement initiatives.

  • Employee Groups and opportunities to connect with colleagues across the organization.

  • Opportunity to work in an award-winning company culture recognized by Glassdoor, Newsweek, and LinkedIn.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer based in Brazil.

As a Senior Analytics Engineer, you will play a key role in developing a world-class data platform supporting a leading global mining operation. You will work at the intersection of data engineering and business intelligence, transforming complex operational data into reliable, reusable, and actionable insights. Your work will empower business leaders to make faster, data-driven decisions across international operations. Collaborating with data engineers, analytics architects, and senior stakeholders, you will design scalable data products and establish robust data modelling practices. You will also contribute to predictive analytics, KPI frameworks, and enterprise-wide reporting standards. This role offers the opportunity to influence data strategy and drive innovation within a global, technology-driven environment.

lists.content:
You will lead the development and delivery of high-quality data products, ensuring that operational data is transformed into reliable assets that support analytics, reporting, and machine learning initiatives.

  • Design and build data products across the full data lifecycle, from data ingestion and transformation to serving and consumption.

  • Develop robust, scalable, and well-documented data models in collaboration with business users, data engineers, and analytics architects.

  • Extract, transform, and validate data from diverse sources, including JSON and XML feeds, applying effective metadata management practices.

  • Deliver clean, tested, and code-reviewed datasets and data pipelines ready for analytical and machine learning applications.

  • Collaborate with senior stakeholders to define KPI frameworks, reporting standards, and data governance best practices.

  • Work closely with data engineering teams to enhance data product design and integrate datasets for predictive models.

  • Create and maintain dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI to support data-driven decision-making.

  • Evaluate existing data flows and recommend improvements, influencing platform architects and engineers to optimize data processes.

  • Implement data validation, monitoring, and error-handling mechanisms to ensure data quality, consistency, and accuracy.

  • Maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including data dictionaries and data lineage artefacts.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate combines extensive experience in data engineering and analytics with strong technical expertise, problem-solving abilities, and the capacity to translate complex data into meaningful business insights.

  • At least 8 years of experience in data analytics, data engineering, or a closely related software engineering discipline.

  • Strong SQL skills for data extraction and manipulation, with deep expertise in data modelling and indexing strategies.

  • Hands-on experience with Azure cloud services for data storage and processing, such as Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse Analytics, or equivalent platforms.

  • Proficiency in Databricks for building data products and performing large-scale data transformations.

  • Experience working with and transforming semi-structured data formats, particularly JSON and XML.

  • Solid understanding of data governance, data quality principles, and security best practices.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to present technical findings and data insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

    • Nice-to-have qualifications:

  • Experience with additional cloud providers, such as AWS or Google Cloud Platform, alongside Azure.

  • Previous experience in mining, commodities, or heavy industry operational data.

  • Proficiency in additional languages beyond English.

    • Benefits

  • Flexible working arrangements, including remote, office-based, or hybrid options.

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive compensation package.

  • Personalized career development and growth opportunities.

  • Professional development resources, including mentorship programs, technical talks, training sessions, and Centers of Excellence.

  • Active technical communities with regular knowledge-sharing opportunities.

  • Education reimbursement to support continuous learning.

  • Anniversary gifts and recognition.

  • Corporate events and team-building activities.

  • Additional benefits depending on the employee's location.

Overview

Join a global clinical research environment dedicated to advancing healthcare and improving patient outcomes through innovative clinical development solutions. As a Senior Clinical Payment Associate, you will oversee complex clinical site payment activities across the Americas, ensuring financial accuracy, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance. You will manage high-risk payment portfolios, interpret contractual requirements, and lead the resolution of challenging financial discrepancies. Working closely with clinical operations, finance teams, investigative sites, and external vendors, you will contribute to seamless payment processes throughout the clinical trial lifecycle. You will also provide technical guidance to colleagues and support regional initiatives, process improvements, and financial oversight. This remote opportunity requires strong financial expertise and multilingual communication skills to support stakeholders across diverse markets.

lists.content:
As a Senior Clinical Payment Associate, you will independently manage complex clinical payment operations, oversee financial processes, and ensure accurate and timely investigator grant and site payments. You will act as a subject matter expert, supporting operational teams, resolving escalated issues, and driving continuous improvements across regional payment activities.

  • Independently manage complex study and country payment portfolios involving multiple vendors, currencies, payment models, tax requirements, and documentation processes.

  • Interpret Clinical Trial Agreement (CTA) payment terms and site budgets, translating contractual requirements into operational payment instructions.

  • Lead the resolution of aged, disputed, historical, and cross-functional payment issues through root cause analysis, corrective actions, and stakeholder communication.

  • Oversee external vendor performance against Statements of Work (SOWs), identify delivery gaps, monitor performance trends, and escalate significant risks.

  • Conduct budget-versus-actual analyses, funding sufficiency assessments, financial forecasting, and variance reviews for assigned portfolios.

  • Lead or co-lead regional payment projects, process improvement initiatives, internalization activities, workflow development, testing, and implementation.

  • Develop operational guidance, job aids, and controls for country-specific payment processes while maintaining audit-ready documentation.

  • Coach and guide Payment Associates, review complex deliverables, and promote consistent operational practices without direct supervisory responsibility.

  • Independently prioritize competing assignments, manage deliverables with minimal supervision, and recommend appropriate risk mitigation strategies.

  • Ensure accurate setup, review, execution, and reconciliation of investigator grants and clinical site payments in accordance with approved budgets, executed agreements, internal procedures, and local requirements.

  • Collaborate with investigative sites, Clinical Operations, Clinical Site Contracts, Budget Development, Finance, Accounts Payable, and external payment vendors to resolve questions and discrepancies.

  • Maintain accurate payment records, trackers, supporting documentation, and system data throughout the clinical study lifecycle.

  • Monitor invoices, payment statuses, outstanding actions, and aging items, escalating potential delays and risks when necessary.

  • Apply country-specific banking, tax documentation, invoicing, and communication requirements across the Americas.

  • Ensure compliance with confidentiality standards, financial controls, segregation-of-duties requirements, and applicable procedures.

  • Use relevant systems and tools, including ClinRun, Greenphire, Oracle CTMS, Veeva, SAP, Ariba, Microsoft Excel, SharePoint, Teams, Smartsheet, and Power BI.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate will have a strong background in clinical research payments, financial operations, or pharmaceutical industry processes, with demonstrated experience managing complex portfolios and resolving non-routine payment challenges. A combination of financial expertise, analytical capabilities, and effective communication skills is essential, alongside the ability to collaborate with international stakeholders across different regions.

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Life Sciences, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

  • At least 4 years of relevant industry experience, or 5+ years in clinical research or the pharmaceutical industry.

  • Substantial experience in clinical site payments, investigator grants, financial operations, or related activities.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex payment portfolios, interpret contractual payment terms, and resolve non-routine operational issues.

  • Experience working with clinical site payment vendors and financial systems.

  • Experience with SAP and Ariba is required or strongly preferred, depending on local hiring standards.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including financial reconciliation, root cause analysis, forecasting, and budget-versus-actual assessments.

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and working knowledge of Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, Smartsheet, and Power BI.

  • Ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority, mentor colleagues, and communicate risks and recommendations effectively to leadership.

  • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing priorities independently.

  • Fluent written and spoken English is required.

  • Professional proficiency in written and spoken Spanish is required, particularly to support investigative sites and stakeholders in Mexico and Argentina.

  • Portuguese proficiency is strongly preferred to support Brazilian investigative sites.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively across North American and Latin American time zones and business environments.

    • Benefits:

  • Remote working opportunity based in Brazil.

  • Opportunity to work within an international clinical research environment.

  • Exposure to complex clinical payment portfolios and global financial operations.

  • Collaboration with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders across the Americas.

  • Opportunities to contribute to regional projects, process improvements, and operational initiatives.

  • Professional development through subject matter expertise, knowledge sharing, and mentoring responsibilities.

  • Opportunity to contribute to clinical research activities that support the development of innovative treatments and improved patient outcomes.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior CRM Data Analyst based in Brazil.

As a Senior CRM Data Analyst, you will own the analytics workstream for client accounts, turning complex customer and commercial data into actionable insights that support smarter CRM and business decisions. You will manage analytical requests from initial intake through analysis, validation, and final presentation, taking full ownership of the process. Working within collaborative CRM teams, you will partner with consultants, account managers, project managers, and client stakeholders across marketing, loyalty, and data functions. Your work will cover customer behavior, transaction trends, segmentation, retention, experimentation, and revenue performance. You will also develop reliable dashboards, strengthen data quality, and translate findings into clear strategic recommendations. This is a hands-on, client-facing role in a remote-first, international environment where analytical rigor, commercial thinking, and independent execution are highly valued.

lists.content:
You will lead analytics delivery across assigned client accounts, ensuring that every analysis is accurate, relevant, and aligned with business priorities. You will combine advanced technical skills with strong stakeholder management to turn data requests into meaningful insights and measurable recommendations.

  • Analytics Ownership & Client Collaboration

  • Own the analytics workstream for assigned accounts, managing request intake and prioritization within agreed working hours.

  • Act as the primary point of contact for client data and analytics questions, ensuring requests are clearly framed and based on sound assumptions.

  • Identify when requests exceed the agreed scope or require a dedicated project, communicating this proactively to relevant stakeholders.

  • Collaborate with Lead and Senior Consultants, Account Management, and Project Management, as well as client marketing, loyalty, and data teams.

  • Manage analytical assignments independently, from initial client request through final presentation and recommendations.

  • Data Analysis & Technical Execution

  • Write production-quality SQL in client data warehouses such as Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, or equivalent platforms.

  • Develop the transformation logic required to support reliable analysis and reporting.

  • Trace data lineage, identify and resolve gaps in existing reports, SQL queries, and data events.

  • Reconcile metrics across different systems, including product and digital analytics platforms such as Amplitude and Google Analytics 4.

  • Conduct cohort, behavioral, and decomposition analyses using customer, transaction, and loyalty data.

  • Analyze key commercial metrics, including first and repeat purchases, average transaction value, revenue, purchase frequency, retention, lifetime value, and offer performance.

  • Build or leverage propensity and segmentation models to identify customer opportunities and improve targeting.

  • Connect insights across customer segments, offers, channels, and seasonality to revenue growth, operational efficiency, and cost savings.

  • Experimentation & Performance Measurement

  • Independently design and report on experiments, including sample size calculations, holdout group design, and incremental uplift measurement.

  • Analyze test results and performance variations across customer segments.

  • Use AI tools to accelerate analytical workflows, improve testing efficiency, and strengthen the quality of insights.

  • Reporting, Dashboards & Data Quality

  • Build and maintain dashboards using business intelligence platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent tools.

  • Define, document, and maintain the KPIs and measurement logic behind reporting solutions.

  • Validate and document all figures before sharing results with clients or internal stakeholders.

  • Present analytical findings and recommendations through clear, compelling, and strategic narratives tailored to senior and non-technical audiences.

  • Team Development & Knowledge Sharing

  • Review other analysts' SQL and provide guidance on analytical quality and best practices.

  • Coach consultants on using data effectively to support client recommendations.

  • Manage and mentor one to two junior analysts as the team expands.

  • Develop reusable analytical assets, frameworks, and reporting approaches that can be applied across multiple client accounts.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines advanced SQL and data analytics expertise with strong commercial awareness and the ability to communicate confidently with clients. You should be comfortable owning analytical projects independently, challenging assumptions, and translating complex findings into practical business recommendations.

  • Strong experience writing production-quality SQL in Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse, such as Databricks or Amazon Redshift.

  • Experience building dashboards and reporting solutions using BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.

  • Advanced Excel skills.

  • Experience with product or digital analytics platforms such as Amplitude, Google Analytics 4, or Mixpanel.

  • Hands-on experience conducting cohort and behavioral analyses using customer, transaction, or loyalty data.

  • Strong understanding of data quality, validation, and governance practices.

  • Experience with experimentation and statistical analysis using Python or R, including test design, sample size calculations, statistical significance, and incremental uplift measurement.

  • Experience developing or applying propensity and customer segmentation models, including recency and frequency segments or activity-based tiers.

  • Background in CRM, loyalty, or customer analytics, supported by strong commercial judgment and the ability to challenge unclear or misleading analytical requests.

  • Excellent client-facing English communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings and business implications clearly to non-technical stakeholders, both verbally and in writing.

  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to independently manage competing priorities and deliver accurate results.

    • Nice to Have:

  • Experience with CRM engagement platforms such as Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC), or Adobe Campaign, including an understanding of how customer segments and insights are used within these platforms.

  • Familiarity with Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) such as Hightouch, Segment, or similar solutions.

  • Experience in quick-service restaurants (QSR), restaurant, or retail industries.

  • Experience with uplift modeling.

  • Previous experience in an agency or consultancy environment; candidates from in-house teams with strong stakeholder-facing responsibilities are also encouraged to apply.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully remote, remote-first working environment, with the flexibility to work from wherever you feel most productive.

  • Opportunities for accelerated professional growth through challenging projects and continuous learning.

  • Supportive and collaborative culture focused on employee development and shared success.

  • Opportunity to work with international colleagues across Europe, the United States, and other regions.

  • Clear career progression, meaningful ownership, and opportunities to take on greater responsibilities.

  • Team meetups, events, and experiences that encourage connection and collaboration.

lists.content:
As a Senior Data Analyst, you will lead data analysis and reporting activities, transforming information from multiple sources into clear, reliable insights for business stakeholders and senior leadership. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Data Collection and Analysis: Collect, validate, analyze, and interpret data from different systems to support business reporting, operational analysis, and strategic decision-making.

  • Dashboard Development: Design, build, and maintain advanced Power BI dashboards, including complex executive reporting solutions and interactive visualizations.

  • Reporting and Performance Metrics: Develop consolidated reports for different stakeholders and establish operational KPIs, financial indicators, and business performance metrics.

  • Data Modeling: Validate dimensional data models to ensure alignment with business reporting requirements, including the appropriate use of star schemas, fact tables, and dimension tables.

  • Data Quality Assurance: Perform data quality checks, validation, and reconciliation between source systems and data warehouses, identifying and resolving inconsistencies or discrepancies.

  • SQL Analysis: Use advanced SQL to query databases, validate data, conduct ad hoc analysis, and generate insights that address business questions.

  • Business and Financial Analysis: Work directly with finance and delivery stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze performance, and develop reporting solutions covering financial results, P&L, and operational metrics.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and operate a scalable data platform that transforms information from multiple sources into reliable, up-to-date company intelligence. In this role, you will take end-to-end ownership of data infrastructure, from system architecture and ingestion to transformation, orchestration, and production operations. You will work with diverse data sources and build robust pipelines capable of handling high-volume, concurrent workloads. Your work will ensure data quality, consistency, and availability for downstream products and business applications. Collaborating within a data and infrastructure team, you will have the opportunity to shape technical foundations and introduce efficient, resilient data workflows. This is an ideal opportunity for an engineer who enjoys solving complex data challenges and building reliable systems in a fast-moving environment.

lists.content:
As a Senior Data Engineer, you will own the development and continuous improvement of a multi-source data platform, ensuring that information is ingested, processed, validated, and made available reliably. You will combine strong engineering practices with a focus on scalability, automation, and operational excellence.

  • Design and build a multi-source data platform supporting concurrent ingestion, event-driven processing, and orchestrated batch workflows.

  • Develop ingestion pipelines for APIs, webhooks, files, and web scraping, incorporating rate-limit management and robust failure-handling mechanisms.

  • Orchestrate scheduled workflows and historical data backfills using tools such as Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect.

  • Build messaging and task queue workflows with retries, dead-letter queues, and controlled replay capabilities.

  • Store original data payloads in cloud object storage and transform information with dbt into raw, standardized, and curated data layers.

  • Implement idempotent upserts, data contracts, automated validation, pipeline testing, and monitoring systems to track data freshness and failures.

  • Design and optimize PostgreSQL schemas, data models, and loading patterns to support performance and reliability.

  • Integrate data enrichment capabilities and LLM-based structured extraction into data workflows.

  • Take ownership of platform architecture, deployment, production operations, and ongoing improvements.

  • Identify bottlenecks and strengthen pipeline reliability, scalability, and maintainability.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate brings substantial experience building and operating production-grade data platforms, with the ability to take technical ownership from initial architecture through deployment and ongoing operations. You should have strong programming and database skills, practical cloud infrastructure experience, and a solid understanding of asynchronous and event-driven systems.

  • At least 5 years of experience building and operating production data platforms, with end-to-end ownership from architecture through deployment and maintenance.

  • Production experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), dbt, and workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or Temporal.

  • Strong Python programming skills, including asynchronous HTTP and concurrent processing with technologies such as asyncio, aiohttp, or HTTPX.

  • Advanced SQL and PostgreSQL skills, including data modeling, query optimization, and incremental loading strategies.

  • Experience designing and operating event-driven systems, messaging or task queues, asynchronous processing, and failure recovery mechanisms.

  • Familiarity with data contracts, raw and curated storage layers, retention policies, automated testing, and data quality monitoring.

  • Ability to design resilient ingestion and transformation pipelines that handle large volumes of data and multiple source formats.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make sound architectural decisions independently.

  • Experience working in a startup or small engineering team is an advantage.

  • Additional experience with web scraping, entity resolution, data enrichment, or LLM-based data extraction is a plus.

    • Benefits:

  • Annual base salary of $80,000–$120,000 USD, depending on experience.

  • Full-time, fully remote position.

  • Remote work opportunity for candidates based in Latin America.

  • Opportunity to take end-to-end ownership of a data platform and influence its architecture and technical direction.

  • Exposure to modern cloud infrastructure, data engineering technologies, event-driven systems, and AI-powered data enrichment.

  • Opportunity to contribute to a technically challenging product in a collaborative engineering environment.

lists.content:

  • Build scalable and repeatable infrastructure for regional platform deployments using Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code practices.

  • Develop real-time data processing, analytics, and alerting capabilities to support operational and product requirements.

  • Collaborate with AI and Data Science teams to establish platform foundations for agentic workflows, model evaluations, and machine learning lifecycle tooling.

  • Improve data cataloging, governance frameworks, and access controls to ensure data remains discoverable, secure, and properly managed.

  • Take ownership of platform reliability through observability, on-call participation, incident response, and continuous operational improvements.

  • Work closely with cross-functional engineering teams to identify technical challenges and deliver effective platform solutions.

  • Contribute to the evolution of distributed data infrastructure as transaction volumes, customer needs, and product capabilities expand.

  • Drive technical improvements across platform architecture, deployment automation, performance, and operational efficiency.

    • Requirements

  • At least 5 years of experience in data infrastructure, platform engineering, or software engineering, with demonstrated end-to-end ownership of production systems.

  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience developing reliable data pipelines, services, and platform tooling.

  • Hands-on experience building or operating distributed data systems, including query engines, lakehouse architectures, or streaming platforms.

  • Experience managing cloud infrastructure using Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code, and automated deployment processes.

  • Experience with AI and agent infrastructure, such as MCP servers, retrieval systems, agent observability, or LLM evaluation frameworks.

  • Experience supporting machine learning infrastructure using MLflow, Vertex AI, or similar platforms.

  • Fully remote working environment.

  • Opportunity to collaborate with a globally distributed team of experienced engineers and technology professionals.

We are looking for a seasoned Data Scientist to shape the modelling and statistical foundations of an innovative AI-powered decision-intelligence platform. In this senior role, you will take ownership of the full machine-learning lifecycle, from translating complex business challenges into modelling strategies to deploying, monitoring, and improving production models. You will combine applied statistics, machine learning, and Generative AI to develop scalable solutions that deliver meaningful business insights across multiple industries. Working closely with clients and cross-functional teams, you will lead technical discussions, guide solution design, and communicate complex findings to both technical and executive audiences. This fully remote opportunity offers significant technical ownership, exposure to diverse business challenges, and the chance to influence the development of advanced AI solutions.

lists.content:
• Lead model selection, feature engineering, and evaluation strategies across client projects and engagements.

  • Translate business challenges into well-defined data science problems, establishing success metrics, data requirements, and robust validation methodologies.

  • Develop, deploy, and maintain machine-learning models throughout their lifecycle, from initial experimentation to production monitoring and retraining.

  • Monitor model performance, identify data and model drift, and implement appropriate improvements to maintain reliability and accuracy.

  • Design reusable modelling approaches and frameworks that can be adapted across different industries and business contexts.

  • Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs), embeddings, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) capabilities into solutions where relevant.

  • Lead client discovery sessions, technical workshops, and presentations, communicating recommendations effectively to technical teams and senior stakeholders.

  • Establish and promote best practices for model quality, reproducibility, responsible AI, and engineering standards.

  • Mentor junior data scientists, support their technical development, and produce clear, comprehensive technical documentation.

  • Collaborate with leadership and product development teams to align modelling initiatives with platform objectives and client needs.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 6 years of professional experience in data science or applied machine learning, with a proven track record of developing and deploying production-ready solutions using Python.

  • Strong applied statistics expertise, including Bayesian inference, time-series forecasting, and causal inference.

  • Advanced knowledge of feature engineering, model selection, cross-validation, bias-variance trade-offs, and model or data drift detection.

  • Solid software engineering skills, including typed Python, pytest, and SQL, particularly with PostgreSQL.

  • Familiarity with columnar databases such as ClickHouse is an advantage.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain, justify, and defend modelling decisions and results to non-technical audiences and executive stakeholders.

  • Good understanding of data governance, information security, and regulatory compliance in client-facing environments.

  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, embeddings, and RAG architectures, including prompt engineering and model fine-tuning, is highly desirable.

  • Familiarity with vector databases such as Pinecone, Qdrant, FAISS, or Azure AI Search is an advantage.

  • Experience with service ownership and deployment technologies such as FastAPI, CI/CD pipelines, and schema migrations is beneficial.

  • Knowledge of causal and Bayesian tools such as DoWhy, PyMC, and statsmodels, as well as bandits or sequential decision-making approaches, is a plus.

  • Previous experience in the pharmaceutical or life sciences sector is highly valued.

  • Strong analytical thinking, autonomy, adaptability, and the ability to work effectively with international teams and clients.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully remote working arrangement, with the flexibility to work from anywhere in the world.

  • Opportunity to shape the core intelligence and modelling capabilities of an advanced AI-powered platform.

  • Exposure to diverse business challenges and real-world projects across seven industries.

  • End-to-end ownership of machine-learning solutions, from problem definition and experimentation through to production deployment and monitoring.

  • Collaboration with an international, AI-focused team and opportunities to engage with global clients.

  • Senior-level technical responsibility and the opportunity to influence modelling standards, solution architecture, and responsible AI practices.

  • Flexible remote environment offering opportunities for professional growth and meaningful technical impact.
